verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Modern Horizons and M19 definitions. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
review_notes: 47 alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared local substitutions; 29 structured definitions receive focused source review and one combined target build.
Preserve ordinary activation cleanup/resolution, ETB exits, pitch-spell/change-target routes, repeated target unmarking, spell fizzle behavior and flashback cleanup.

Wrenn retains two reverse scans, first-player snapshots, fresh current_turn between scans, saved-turn assignment and cached damage priority. Sisay keeps its cached first player and fresh second player. Endling keeps keyword snapshots, priority branches and per-mode payment.

Kaya Guile rereads its info slot for each of four ordered modes after previous callbacks; casting keeps the original dialog priorities and entwine selection. Mirrodin Besieged rereads mode following triggers and token generation.

Sliver shared abilities retain leave-status updates, post-kill humiliation queries, cleanup calls and the Hollowhead source-record overwrite. Undying retains detach writes, grave/reanimation queries and cleanup behavior.

Hogaak retains the grave index, per-entry ID rechecks, temporary face-down/face-up work, shifted target slots, convoke-before-delve exile and callback-sensitive values. Force of Vigor retains special-flag queries and duplicated target-unmarking paths.

M19 death helpers retain source validation/control following, distinct dying/kill-code checks, source-death early return, detach flags, pending counts, low-byte masking, cleanup and repeated status queries. Finding a duplicate legacy still performs the later death/trigger work.

Liliana keeps graveyard-pointer refreshes after eligibility callbacks, separate legality/mana/timing checks, can-activate result 99, and the existing selected list-index argument. Contract keeps cached first player, fresh second player and uncapped distinct-name filtering. Chaos Wand keeps reveal counts and different bottom counts for unavailable/declined/cast spells. Shield Mare keeps its ETB source-loss exit.
No new tests, historical replay, broad native semantic harness or reccmp refresh for this readability batch.
status: Applied 76-definition Modern Horizons/M19 readability batch; one combined target build follows. Reccmp deferred.
